description: Speaker diarization: who speaks when, in turns, with no words. Finds the number of voices by itself and handles overlapping speech. Pair it with a transcriber to give each heard word its voice. Experimental.

settings.label: Overlapping speech
settings.description: Off: one voice at a time, the one that talks most when several do (what you want for pairing with a transcript). On: every voice that talks, so turns can overlap.

settings.label: Number of voices
settings.description: How many voices there are, when you know. 0 finds out by itself.

settings.label: At least
settings.description: The fewest voices to find. 0: no limit. Ignored when the number of voices is given.

settings.label: At most
settings.description: The most voices to find. 0: no limit. Ignored when the number of voices is given.
